title: Complete Guide to Browser Privacy
metaDescription: Learn how to protect your privacy in any web browser. Covers settings, extensions, and advanced techniques.
intro: Your web browser is the main gateway to the internet and a major source of data leakage. This guide covers everything you need to know.
prerequisites: A desktop or mobile web browser

steps.title: Audit Your Current Browser Settings
steps.description: Before making changes, understand your current privacy exposure.
steps.proTip: Use a browser privacy test like Cover Your Tracks to see what sites can detect about you.

steps.title: Configure Core Privacy Settings
steps.description: Adjust the fundamental privacy settings in your browser for baseline protection.
actions: Turn off autofill for addresses and payment methods
steps.warning: Some websites may break when third-party cookies are blocked.

steps.title: Install Privacy Extensions
steps.description: Browser extensions can significantly improve your privacy.
actions: Install uBlock Origin for ad and tracker blocking
Install Privacy Badger for intelligent tracker blocking
Consider HTTPS Everywhere for secure connections
steps.proTip: Don't install too many extensions as they increase your browser fingerprint uniqueness.

steps.title: Consider a Privacy Browser
steps.description: For maximum privacy, consider a browser built specifically for privacy.
actions: Try Incognito Browser for built-in privacy features
Evaluate Brave, Firefox Focus, or Tor Browser
Set your chosen privacy browser as default

faqs.question: Does incognito mode make me anonymous?
faqs.answer: No. Incognito mode only prevents your browser from saving local history and cookies. Your ISP, employer, and websites can still see your activity.

faqs.question: Are privacy browsers slower than Chrome?
faqs.answer: Most privacy browsers perform comparably to Chrome. Many are faster because they block ads and trackers that slow down page loading.
